result.method: CPU float64 L2/differences/cosines on saved token vectors; final reference is the last raw post-block residual. Collector statistics use float32. Final norm is a distinct checkpoint, not a residual block.

result.comparison_note: Compared against original retained final-position output.
result.method: Each saved embedding/post-block residual → independently applied resident final RMSNorm → resident LM head over full vocabulary. Captured final-normalized checkpoint uses head only; no double normalization. Diagnostic Logit Lens, not intermediate predictions or causal evidence.
result.rank_policy: Descending full-vocabulary logit; exact ties use ascending vocabulary ID (stable sort).
result.probability_policy: Full-vocabulary CPU float64 softmax, returned probabilities cast to float32; never display-only normalization.
